description: B30 (switch-in handlers sort by action Speed). ko-replace with a Choice Scarf on Pelipper: after the double KO of the setup turn, Abomasnow (Snow Warning) and Pelipper (Drizzle) come in at equal raw Speed 85, but `switchIn` queues each `runSwitch` through `insertChoice`, which calls `updateSpeed()`, so Pelipper's `pokemon.speed` is its action Speed with the Scarf (127): Drizzle runs first, Snow Warning second, and snow remains with probability 1 (raw Speeds would tie: 1/2 each).
